notes.title: March 29 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your support of Miryam: The Polluted Land! Today, we’ve released a new patch update, adjusting the difficulty of certain levels and optimizing the overall gameplay experience based on player feedback.

[h3]Update Details[/h3]
🔹 Adjustments
1. Reduced the difficulty of the first 9 levels to make it easier for new players to get started.

🔹 New Features
2. Added an option to skip cutscenes, so you can jump straight into the action.

🔹 Optimizations
3. Improved targeting behavior for defensive structures to enhance combat accuracy.
4. Made the skip button for the prologue cutscene more visible and easier to use.

We’ll continue to listen to your feedback and improve the game! If you encounter any issues while playing, feel free to share them in the community—we’ll work on fixes as soon as possible.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

— Miryam: The Polluted Land Development Team

notes.title: Miryam: The Polluted Land – Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the Land of Nod in this innovative tower defense game developed by 6.5F Studio and published by Vsoo Games. With a rich narrative, strategic gameplay, and unique enemies, Miryam: The Polluted Land offers a fresh and immersive twist on the classic tower defense genre.

[h1]Game Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] 40+ Unique Enemies: Face a variety of grotesque creatures, each with its own attack patterns and weaknesses.
[*] 20+ Defensive Structures: From explosive clay pots to moths that clear fog, strategically deploy defenses to fend off the horrors.
[*] 40+ Challenging Levels: Test your strategic skills in diverse stages with increasing difficulty.
[*] A Dark Storyline: Follow Miryam’s journey through the haunted Land of Nod as she battles creatures born from her own fears.
[/list]

In Miryam: The Polluted Land, you won’t just be defending your territory—you’ll be facing your past. The game’s narrative dives deep into Miryam’s journey of overcoming her inner demons while defending against nightmarish enemies.

Available Now on Steam – Get 10% Off for the First Two Weeks!
Don’t miss out on the launch discount—Miryam: The Polluted Land is available for $4.99/£4.29/€4.99 (or your local equivalent). Act fast to grab this limited-time offer!
